subject: Finding the cabin microfilter cover at the base of the windshield, on a 2010 BMW 328i (E90) with the 3.0L inline-6, shown so a home mechanic can see what the step is about. Step: "Locate the cover".

mustShow.text: HERO: A long black plastic cover running along the base of the windshield in the engine bay, in front of the wipers.
The 8 mm screws that hold the cover and its ducts; shown as screw heads without a specific count.
